title: No Villager Trades
description: Removes the ability to trade with villagers
body:
(FIXED) Villagers can no longer trade! Right clicking on a villager with a job makes them shake their head the same way a jobless villager does. No trade ui will pop up, but they still can wear job outfits and lose their job and get a new one just like a normal villager.

![Interaction](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LYNG8qrk/images/3283bc4f80aaac45adc6d0a617e04486f91fe78a.png)
